uncited: **Construct SVO:** Sample the geometry into the stored octree.
**Consolidate Deformations:** Replace complex rig emulations with a set of blend shapes.
**Group Assets:** Combine dense asset groups into fewer, larger voxel spaces by creating a single generator definition containing multiple SVO instances.
**Animate via Blend Shapes:** Procedurally select and trigger blend shapes to deform the static SVO.
**Render:** Pass the voxel grid to the renderer.
*   **Overlapping Elements:** Static SVOs with overlapping geometry (e.g., feathers) may not separate cleanly when animated.
*   **World-Space Material Dependencies:** Materials requiring world-space orientation (e.g., side-specific wing coloring) fail if only local data is stored.
*   **Rig Emulation Cost:** Attempting to emulate complex rigs (thousands of joints) at render time is inefficient.
*   **Strengths:** Consistent input to the renderer, reduced memory footprint, faster voxelization, efficient handling of thousands of assets.
*   **Limitations:** Requires offline preparation; static SVOs may suffer from overlap artifacts if not carefully posed; blend shapes may not capture all rig nuances.
